title: Riders paid a median $6.87/mile in Sep 2026

subtitles.fpm_by_mode: Uber had the lowest median fare per mile in Sep 2026, $6.60/mile, and yellow cabs the highest, $7.67/mile
subtitles.fpm_by_hour: Fares per mile were lowest on Tue 3 am ($4.21/mile) and highest on Thu 5 pm ($7.13/mile) over the 3 months to Sep 2026
subtitles.fpm_by_borough: Manhattan had the highest overall fare per mile (total fares ÷ total miles), $6.40/mile across all modes, over the 3 months to Sep 2026
subtitles.volatility_by_zone: Fares per mile varied most for Uber trips from Garment District in Sep 2026, where the 90th-percentile fare per mile was 5.9× the 10th
subtitles.volatility_by_zone_lyft: Fares per mile varied most for Lyft trips from Garment District in Sep 2026, where the 90th-percentile fare per mile was 4.3× the 10th
